spans.s:
निल् निल्, cl. 6. P. निलति, &c., to un-
derstand with difficulty, to be impassable
or impenetrable; [cf. नि-ली below.]

नील् नील् (rather a Nom. derived fr.
नील below), cl. 1. P. नीलति, &c., to be
of a dark colour; to dye dark, make or dye blue.

निलय् निल्-अय् (= निर्-अय्), cl. 1. A. -अयते,
-यितुम्, to go out; [cf. rt. इ and rt. अय्.]

1. निल्-अयन, अम्, n. (for 2. see under नि-ली
below), the act of going out.

2. नि-लयन, अम्, n. (for 1. see p. 502, col. 3),
settling in a place, alighting; place of refuge, dwelling-
place, dwelling, habitation.
नि-लायन, अम्, n. the act of hiding one's self.

निलिम्प नि-लिम्प, अस्, m. (fr. rt. लिप् with
नि), Ved., N. of a particular class of supernatural
beings; a troop of Maruts; a god in general; (आ),
f. a cow.
—निलिम्प-निर्झरी, f. the river of the
gods, the Gaṅgā.
निलिम्पिका, f. a cow.

निली नि-ली, cl. 4. A. -लीयते, -लेतुम् and
-लातुम्, to lie down, settle down, alight; to hide
[]
one's self, disappear, conceal one's self from (with
abl.); to sink down, perish, (नि-लिल्यिरे, they perished,
Mahā-bh. Sauptika-p. 399.)

नि-लय, अस्, m. hiding one's self; a hiding-place;
the lair or den of animals, a nest; dwelling, abode,
residence, house, habitation; (often at the end of a
comp. in the sense of) having one's residence,
living, residing in (e. g. कैलास-निलय, residing
in Kailāsa).

नीलाय, Nom. P. A. नीलायति, -ते, &c., to be-
come blue or dark-coloured.

निलायि-ता, f. dwelling, residing in, the being
domesticated.
नि-लायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, dwelling in, inhabiting.

नि-लीन, अस्, आ, अम्, fused in or into; involved, en-
compassed, surrounded, shut or wrapt up, embraced,
destroyed, perished; transformed, changed; full.

निलीनक, अस्, अम्, m. n. (?), N. of a village in
the north country; [cf. नैलीनक.]
नि-लीयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, hiding, lying concealed.

नील, अस्, आ or ई, अम् (probably fr. निश् + ल =
निश्ल = निल्ल = नील; according to Pāṇ.

,
the fem. form नीला is used in relation to clothes &c.,
and नीली in relation to plants, animals, &c.; in proper
names either form is allowed), of a dark colour,
[]
(especially dark-blue or black); dyed with indigo;
(अस्), m. dark-blue or black (the colour); a gem,
the sapphire; the Indian fig-tree (= वट); a species
of bird, the blue or hill Maina; an ox or bull of
a dark colour; one of the nine Nidhis or divine
treasures of Kuvera; N. of a man, the prince of
Māhiṣmatī; of a son of Yadu; of a historian of
Kaśmīra; an epithet of Mañju-śrī; N. of a Nāga;
of one of the monkey-chiefs attending on Rāma,
(said to be a son of Agni); the blue mountain, one
of the principal ranges of mountains dividing the
world into nine portions and lying immediately north
of Ilāvṛta or the central division [cf. नीलाद्रि]; (आ),
f. the indigo plant, Indigofera Tinctoria [cf. नीली];
a species of Boerhavia with blue blossoms (= नील-
पुनर्-नवा); a species of blue fly [cf. नीली]; the
two arteries in front of the neck, (in this sense नीले,
f. du.); a black and blue mark on the skin (either
from a bruise or a disease?); a Rāgiṇī or mode of
music, personified as the wife of Rāga Mallāra; (ई),
f. the indigo plant; another plant, Blyxa Saivala (=
शैवल; cf. जल-नीली); a species of blue fly; a
kind of disease (= नीली-रोग, नीलिका); N. of the
wife of Aja-mīḍha [cf. नीलिनी, नलिनी]; (अम्), n.
darkness (Ved.); indigo, the dye; black salt (=
काच-लवण); blue vitriol (= तुत्थ); antimony
(= सौवीराञ्जन); poison (= तालीश-पत्त्र); a
peculiar position in dancing; a kind of metre con-
sisting of four times sixteen syllables; [cf. Lat.
niger for nigro = निश्-र.]
—नील-कणा, f. a species
of cumin.
—नील-कण्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, blue-necked;
(अस्), m. a peacock; a species of gallinule or water-
hen (= दात्यूह); a wag-tail; a sparrow; a blue-
necked jay; the plant Hyperanthera Moringa (=
पीत-सार); an epithet of Śiva (as having a black
throat, so stained by the acrimony of the poison
which he swallowed on its production at the churn-
ing of the ocean); N. of several authors and com-
mentators; (अम्), n. a radish; [cf. काल-कण्ठ.]
—नीलकण्ठ-चम्पू, ऊस्, f., N. of a work by
Nīlakaṇṭha Dīkṣita.
—नीलकण्ठ-तीर्थ, अम्,
n. ‘the bathing-place of Śiva,’ N. of a sacred Tīrtha.
—नीलकण्ठ-भारती, m., N. of an author men-
tioned in the Sarva-darśana-saṅgraha of Mādhavā-
cārya.
—नीलकण्ठ-स्तव, अस्, m. ‘the praise of
Śiva,’ N. of the fifty-first chapter of the Jñāna-
khaṇḍa of the Śiva-Purāṇa.
—नीलकण्ठाक्ष
(˚ठ-अक्˚), अम्, n. the berry or seed of Elæocarpus
Ganitrus.
—नील-कन्द, अस्, m. a species of bulbous
plant (= महिष-कन्द-भेद).
—नील-कमल,
अम्, n. the blue water-lily.
—नील-कायिक, आस्, m.
pl. (with Buddhists) ‘blue-bodied’ or ‘dark-bodied,’
epithet of a class of deities.
—नील-कुन्तला, f., N.
of a female friend of Durgā.
—नील-कुरण्टक,
अस्, m. or नील-कुसुमा, f. or नील-कुरुण्टक, a
species of Barleria with blue blossoms (B. Cœrulea,
= नील-झिण्टी).
—नील-केशी, f. the indigo plant.
—नील-क्रान्ता, f. a species of plant (= विष्णु-
क्रान्ता).
—नील-क्रौञ्च, अस्, m. a species of curlew
or heron.
—नील-गङ्गा, f., N. of a river.
—नील-
गणेश, अस्, m. the blue Gaṇeśa.
—नील-गर्भ,
a young blue water-lily (?).
—नील-गिरि-कर्णिका, f.
a blue variety of Clitoria Ternatea.
—नील-ग्रीव,
अस्, आ, अम्, blue-necked; (अस्), m. an epithet of
Rudra-Śiva or Mahā-deva, (see नील-कण्ठ); N.
of a king.
—नील-घोर, a various reading for नील-
पोर, q. v.
—नील-चर्मन्, अ, n. the tree Xylo-
carpus Granatum.
—नील-च्छद, अस्, m. ‘dark-
leaved,’ the date tree; ‘blue-winged,’ an epithet
of Garuḍa.
—नील-च्छवी, a species of bird (=
कुकु; the right form is probably नील-च्छविन्, ई,
m.).
—नील-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, produced in the blue
mountains; (अम्), n. blue steel; (आ), f. the river
Vitastā.
—नील-झिण्टी, f. blue Barleria (= नील-
कुरण्टक).
—नील-तन्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a Tantra.
—नील-तरु, उस्, m. the cocoa-nut tree.
—नील-ता,
f. blueness, blackness, a blue or dark colour.
—नील-
ताल, अस्, m. Xanthochymus Pictorius; Phœnix
Paludosa.
—नील-दूर्वा, f. a species of plant (=
हरिता).
—नील-द्रुम, अस्, m. a species of tree (=
नीलासन).
—नील-ध्वज, अस्, m. Xanthochymus
[]
Pictorius; N. of a prince of Māhiṣmatī.
—नील-
नख, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. black-clawed, having black
claws.
—नील-निर्गुण्डी, f. a species of Nirguṇḍī
with blue blossoms.
—नील-निर्यासक, अस्, m. a
species of tree (= नीलासन).
—नील-नीरज, अम्, n.
the blue water-lily.
—नील-पक्ष्मन्, आ, आ, अ, having
black eyelashes.
—नील-पङ्क, अम्, n. darkness;
(अस्, अम्), m. n. black mud.
—नील-पटल, अम्, n. a
sort of dark film or membrane over the eye of a blind
person; a dark mass, a black coating or covering.
—नील-पत्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, dark-leaved, having black
or dark-blue leaves; (अस्), m., N. of several plants, Scir-
pus Kysoor; the pomegranate tree; (आ), f. Premna
Herbacea; (अम्), n. the blue water-lily.
—नील-
पद्म, अम्, n. the blue water-lily.
—नील-पर्ण,
अस्, m. Grevia Orientalis; (ई), f. Vanda (= वन्दा)
Roxburghii.
—नील-पाचन, अम्, n. steeping or
maceration of indigo.
—नीलपाचन-भाण्ड, अम्,
n. a vessel for steeping indigo, an indigo vat.
—नील-
पिङ्गल, अस्, आ, अम्, of a dark-brown colour.
—नील-पिच्छ, अस्, m. ‘black-tailed,’ a falcon.
—नील-पिट, अस्, m. (with Buddhists) a collection
of annals and royal edicts.
—नील-पिष्टोडी, f. a
species of shrub (= नीलाम्ली).
—नील-पुनर्-नवा,
f. a species of Punar-navā with blue blossoms.
—नील-पुर, अम्, n., N. of a town.
—नील-
पुराण, अम्, n., N. of a Purāṇa.
—नील-पुष्प,
अस्, m. a species of Verbesina with blue flowers;
(आ), f. a plant (= विष्णु-क्रान्ता); (ई), f. a plant
(= नील-वुह्ना); (अम्), n. a species of fragrant plant
(= ग्रन्थि-पर्ण).
—नील-पुष्पिका, f. the indigo
plant; linseed, Linum Usitatissimum.
—नील-पृष्-
ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. ‘black-backed,’ epithet of
Agni; (अस्), m. a species of fish, commonly called
Rohi, Cyprinus Denticulatus.
—नील-पोर, अस्, m.
a species of sugar-cane.
—नील-भ, अस्, m. ‘having
a bluish or dark appearance,’ the moon; a cloud;
a bee; [cf. नीलाभ.]
—नील-भू, ऊस्, f., N. of a
river.
—नील-भृङ्गराज, अस्, m. a species of
Verbesina with blue blossoms.
—नील-मक्षा, f. a
species of blue fly or bee.
—नील-मणि, इस्, m. a
blue gem, the sapphire.
—नील-मत, अम्, n., N. of
a poem in the Pauranic style, celebrating the sacred
places of Kaśmīra, and said to have been inspired
by Nīla the serpent-king.
—नील-मल्लिका, f. Ægle
Marmelos.
—नील-माधव, अस्, m. an epithet of
Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa (as being of a dark colour).
—नील-माष, अस्, m. Dolichos Catjang.
—नील-
मीलिक, अस्, m. a fire-fly.
—नील-मृत्तिका, f. iron
pyrites; black earth or mould.
—नील-मेहिन्, ई,
इनी, इ, voiding dark or bluish urine.
—नील-यष्-
टिका, f. a species of dark sugar-cane.
—नील-रत्न,
अम्, n. the sapphire.
—नील-राजि, इस्, f. a dark line,
dark row, dark mass.
—नील-रुद्रोपनिषद् (˚र-
उप्˚), त्, f., N. of an Upaniṣad.
—नील-रूपक,
अस्, m. Thespesia Populneoides.
—नील-लोह, अम्,
n. blue steel.
—नील-लोहित, अस्, आ, अम्, dark-blue
mixed with red, purple, of a purple colour, dark-red;
(अस्), m., N. of Rudra-Śiva; N. of a Kalpa; a
mixture of blue and red, a purple colour; (आ), f. a
species of vegetable (= भूमि-जम्बु); N. of a
goddess, the wife of Śiva.
—नील-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
Ved. blackish, dark; (आन्), m., N. of a mountain.
—नील-वर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, blue-coloured, blue, of a
blue colour; (अस् or अम्), m. n. Grevia Orientalis;
radish.
—नीलवर्ण-शृगाल-वत्, ind. like the blue
jackal.
—नील-वल्ली, f. Vanda Roxburghii.
—नील-
वसन, अस्, आ, अम्, wearing dark-blue or black
garments; (अस्), m. the planet Saturn.
—नील-
वस्त्र, अम्, n. a blue or dark garment, dark-
coloured cloth; (अस्, आ, अम्), dressed in dark or blue
garments; (अस्), m. an epithet of Bala-rāma; (आ),
f. an epithet of Durgā.
—नील-वानर, अस्, m. ‘the
blue monkey,’ a species of monkey.
—नील-वासस्,
आस्, आस्, अस्, dressed in dark-blue clothes; (आस्), m.
the planet Saturn.
—नील-वीज, अस्, m. a species of
tree (= नीलासन).
—नील-वुह्ना, f. Convolvulus
Argenteus.
—नील-वृक्ष, अस्, m. a species of
plant (= वातारि).
—नील-वृन्त, अस्, m. (?), a fan.
—नीलवृन्तक, अम्, n. cotton.
—नील-वृष, अस्,
m. a dark-coloured bull; (आ), f. Solanum Melongena.
[]
—नील-व्रत, अम्, n., N. of a kind of religious
ceremony.
—नील-शिखण्ड, अस्, आ, अम्, having
black tufts or locks of hair.
—नील-शिग्रु, उस्, m.
Hyperanthera Moringa.
—नील-षण्ड, अस्, m. a
dark-coloured bull at liberty.
—नील-सन्ध्या, f. =
नील-गिरि-कर्णिका, q. v.
—नील-सरस्वती, f., N.
of a goddess (= तारा).
—नीलसरस्वती-मनु, N. of
an incantation or magical formula.
—नील-सिन्दु-
वार, अस्, m. Vitex Negundo.
—नील-स्कन्दा or
नील-स्कन्धा or नील-स्पन्दा, f. the dark Go-
karṇī.
—नील-स्वरूप, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), N.
of a metre consisting of four lines of eleven syllables
each.
—नीलाक्ष (˚ल-अक्ष), अस्, m. ‘blue-eyed,’
a goose.
—नीलाङ्कित-दल (˚ल-अङ्˚), अस् or अम्,
m. or n. (?), a species of bulbous plant (= तैल-
कन्द).
—नीलाङ्ग (˚ल-अङ्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, dark-
bodied, having a dark-coloured or dark-blue body;
(अस्), m. the Indian crane; the blue jay, Coracias
Indica.
—नीलाञ्जन (˚ल-अञ्˚), अम्, n. antimony;
blue vitriol; (आ), f. lightning; (ई), f. a species of
shrub (= कालाञ्जनी).
—नीलाञ्जसा (˚ल-अञ्˚), f.
lightning [cf. नीलाञ्जना]; N. of an Apsaras or
courtezan of Svarga; N. of a river.
—नीलाद्रि (˚ल-
अद्˚), इस्, m. the mountain Nīla.
—नीलाद्रि-कर्-
णिका, f. or नीलापराजिता (˚ल-अप्˚), f. = नील-गिरि-
कर्णिका.
—नीलाब्ज (˚ल-अब्˚), अम्, n. the blue
water-lily, a blue lotus.
—नीलाभ (˚ल-आभा), अस्,
आ, अम्, blue-looking, blue; (अस्), m. a cloud; [cf.
नील-भ.]
—नीलाभ्र (˚ल-अभ्˚), अस्, m. a dark
cloud.
—नीलाभ्र-संवृत (˚ल-अभ्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
obscured or concealed by dark clouds.
—नीलाम्बर
(˚ल-अम्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, dressed in dark-blue cloth,
wearing a blue garment; (अस्), m. a demon, a
goblin; the planet Saturn; an epithet of Bala-rāma;
(अम्), n. black or dark-blue raiment.
—नीलाम्बु-
जन्मन् (˚ल-अम्˚), अ, n. the blue lotus.
—नीलाम्-
लान (˚ल-अम्˚), अस्, m. a species of plant (in Hindī
कालाकोराठा) = दासी = छादन.
—नीलाम्ली (˚ल-
अम्˚), f. a species of shrub.
—नीलारुण (˚ल-अर्˚),
अस्, m. ‘the dark-red’ or first dawn of day.
—नी-
लालि-कुल-सङ्कुल (˚ल-अल्˚), ‘full of swarms of
blue bees,’ the plant Rosa Glandulifera.
—नीलालु
(˚ल-आलु), उस्, m. a species of bulbous plant (= असि-
तालु).
—नीलाशी, f. the plant Vitex Negundo.
—नी-
लाशोक (˚ल-अश्˚), अस्, m. an Aśoka with blue blos-
soms.
—नीलाश्मन् (˚ल-अश्˚), आ, m. a blue stone, a
sapphire.
—नीलाश्व (˚ल-अश्˚), अस्, m., N. of a dis-
trict.
—नीलासन (˚ल-अस्˚), अस्, m. a species of tree
(= नील-द्रुम, नील-निर्यासक, &c.).
—नीलासुर
(˚ल-अस्˚), अस्, m., N. of the author of the commen-
tary Nava-kaṇḍikā-bhāṣya on Kātyāyana's Śrāddha-
sūtras.
—नीली-राग, अस्, m. an affection which is
unchangeable as the colour of indigo, unalterable
attachment; (अस्, आ, अम्), having the colour of the
indigo plant; ‘as unchangeable as the indigo colour,’
constant in affection; (अस्), m. a firm and constant
friend.
—नीली-सन्धान, अम्, n. fermentation or
maceration of indigo.
—नीलीसन्धान-भाण्ड,
अम्, n. a vessel for steeping indigo, an indigo vat.
—नीलेश्वर (˚ल-ईश्˚), N. of a town on the Mala-
bar shore (Νελκύνδα).
—नीलोत्पल (˚ल-उत्˚), अम्, n.
a blue lotus, the blue water-lily, Nymphæa Cyanea.
—नीलोत्पल-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, formed or consisting
of blue lotuses.
—नीलोत्पलिन्, ई, m. an epithet of
Mañju-śrī, one of the Jaina saints or teachers.
—नी-
लोद (˚ल-उद), अस्, m., N. of an ocean or river with
blue water.
—नीलोपल (˚ल-उप्˚), अम्, n. a blue
stone, lapis lazuli.

नीलक, अस्, आ, अम्, blue, especially an epithet of the
third unknown quantity or of its square; (अस्), m.
the tree Terminalia Tomentosa (= अशन); a species
of bee (?); a species of antelope, A. Picta; a dark-
coloured horse; (इका), f. a species of rank-grow-
ing aquatic plant; = शेफालिका, Nyctanthes Arbor
Tristis; = नीली, the indigo plant; = नील-सिन्दुवार,
a species of medicinal plant; a slight malady, black
and blue marks on the body from bruises &c.; =
नीलिका-काच; N. of a river; (अम्), n. black salt
(= काच-लवण); blue steel; blue vitriol; [cf.
कण्ठ-न्˚, जीन-नीलिका.]

नीलङ्गु, उस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. लग्, to go,
[]
with नि), = नीलाङ्गु, a species of worm growing in
